checks: Use architecture A45 and its matching implementation plan. Dispatch only after qualified runtime/profile, with this exact committed brief already in the actual published dev-006 base.
Bind the current Ready task revision, assignment, approved patch SHA-256, exact base/brief bytes, branch and owned paths; receive, fence-claim and renew through REST/Cord.

Admit no next task until confirmed dev inclusion, owner-attested REST acceptance and current Done. Unknown publication or response retains ownership and requires observation, never blind replay.

Apply the approved portable serial CPU worker patch. Allow only explicitly approved hash-pinned patches and committed briefs; actual Ready/fenced REST claim, renewal and current input binding precede work.

Clamp Git hooks, filters and normalization; verify exact index and committed bytes/modes, sole pinned parent and allowed paths. Never run the unreviewed candidate, invoke models/admin/publication, or replay an unknown write.

Refresh the native quota lease before every new mutating Git/API/file call; retain >=50% high-water and stale/unknown drain. Allow durable checkpoint/reconciliation after drain, but no next write stage or task.
Commit meaningful public tests importing the actual repository script for assignment/patch/scope guards, ownership/renewal, quota expiry/drain, exact Git bytes and unknown-effect reconciliation.
The component cannot attest its own review, validation, gate or publication. The owner separately runs component tests and the full frozen gate; acceptance and current Done gate task two.
